plan.title: Zebrafish larvae drug-treated vs control DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single gene-level Salmon count matrix (12,000 genes x 6 zebrafish larval pool samples, gene symbols in column 1) with a 6-row metadata table carrying one condition column: 3 treated vs 3 control, unpaired, single batch. That design fixes the analysis: a two-group negative-binomial test on raw counts with no covariates, followed by a functional read-out of the ranked result.

T1S1 runs sample-structure QC before any test — blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes, a sample-distance heatmap, and library sizes — because with n=3 per group a single aberrant pool would dominate the contrast, and this is the only chance to see it before the model. T1S2 fits DESeq2 on the raw counts (no pre-scaling; median-of-ratios size factors live inside the model), with a minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in at least 3 samples, the smallest group size), control set explicitly as the reference level, the Wald test for the treated-vs-control contrast, apeglm shrinkage for reporting and ranking, and BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05. The counts came from Salmon, but only the gene-level matrix is on disk — no quant.sf files and no transcript-length matrix — so the length-offset import that the Salmon path normally prescribes is not available; the step must state that it modelled the delivered gene-level integers directly and that a fold change driven purely by isoform-length shift cannot be distinguished. T1S3 repeats the contrast with the edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test as an independent method and reports the overlap; at three replicates per group the two tools disagree most, so the intersection is the defensible set.

T2S1 handles the pathway question. Danio rerio has no curated MSigDB collection, so the step takes two paths and reports both with their limits: fgsea preranked on the full ranked list of tested genes using the DESeq2 Wald statistic (chosen over the shrunken LFC and the signed p-value because it scales the effect by its uncertainty and does not tie at the top), against human hallmark and GO BP sets after a zebrafish-to-human one-to-one ortholog mapping — reporting the mapped share, since every unmapped gene silently leaves the analysis — and in parallel a GO enrichment on the native zebrafish annotation, which loses no genes but is thinner. T2S2 assembles the report.

The binding caveat throughout: three pools per group gives low power. Published benchmarks put detection at a minority of true DE genes at this size, concentrated in large fold changes. The plan does not loosen alpha to compensate, and every step is required to state that an absent gene is not an unchanged gene.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
Low count pre-filter: >=10 counts in at least 3 samples (smallest group size)
~ condition with control as explicit reference level; contrast condition treated vs control; expected-power statement from closed-form sample size given 3 replicates, depth, and BCV
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR with independent filtering, p-value histogram inspected
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic; zebrafish genes mapped to human orthologs, human hallmark and GO BP collections; GO enrichment on native zebrafish annotation as the parallel path

Consolidated report: methods, versions, design, thresholds, n tested, n DE, MA and dispersion plots, p-value histogram, shrunken and unshrunken LFC with SE, DESeq2/edgeR overlap, leading edge genes, ortholog mapping share, power statement, sessionInfo

A merged per-gene table with both methods' log2FC and padj is written
Genes called by only one method are listed with the calling method named; the union is NOT presented as the result
constraints: Use TMM normalization factors inside the edgeR model — do not feed edgeR the DESeq2 size factors or any pre-normalized matrix
Use glmQLFit/glmQLFTest (quasi-likelihood), not the classic exact test or glmLRT
Keep the contrast direction identical to T1S2 (positive = higher in treated) and verify the direction by spot-checking one gene's group means
Treat the DESeq2 result as the primary result and this as a robustness check; do not replace T1S2's table
caveats: Disagreement between the two methods grows at low counts and low replicate numbers — a gene called by one method only is a weaker claim, not a contradiction
The intersection is a conservative set; genes unique to DESeq2 or edgeR are not thereby false

grounding.reason: edgeR quasi-likelihood is the named second method for a 2-11 replicate design (R-0001), and R-0042 requires reporting the two-method overlap as the high-confidence set.

steps.name: Preranked GSEA and GO enrichment
steps.question: Which pathways and biological processes are coordinately shifted between drug-treated and control zebrafish larvae, on the full ranked list of tested genes?
steps.description:
Run fgsea preranked on the FULL list of genes tested in T1S2, ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic (the `stat` column). Two parallel paths, both reported:
(1) Ortholog path — map zebrafish gene symbols to human one-to-one orthologs, then test against a human hallmark collection and a human GO biological-process collection of gene sets. Report the number and percentage of tested zebrafish genes that mapped, and state that unmapped genes leave the analysis.
(2) Native path — run enrichment on the Danio rerio Gene Ontology annotation directly (zebrafish organism annotation package), losing no genes but with thinner, less complete annotation.
For both: restrict sets to 15-500 genes AFTER intersecting with the tested genes, BH-adjust, and collapse gene sets whose leading edges overlap heavily into groups, reporting one representative per group with the full table kept as a supplement. For every significant set report the leading-edge genes with their Wald statistics, and mark leading-edge overlap between reported sets. Set and record a random seed for the permutation step.
steps.context: Input is T1S2's full results table (~all filtered genes with Wald statistic, log2FC and padj) for the treated-vs-control contrast in Danio rerio whole larvae. Reference gene sets needed: a human hallmark collection and a human GO biological process collection (both HGNC symbols) for the ortholog path, and a zebrafish GO annotation for the native path. Human hallmark and human GO BP GMT collections and a zebrafish organism annotation package were present in this environment at planning time; confirm at run time and, if a collection is missing, run the path that is available and state which one was dropped.
acceptance_criteria: fgsea is run on the full ranked list of ALL tested genes — no significance or fold-change cutoff is applied before ranking

The ranking metric is stated in the output as the DESeq2 Wald statistic, with the reason (scaled by its uncertainty; avoids the ties of a signed p-value and the low-count noise of an unshrunken fold change)

Both the ortholog-mapped human-collection path and the native zebrafish GO path are attempted; for the ortholog path the mapped gene count and percentage are reported, for the native path the annotation source and release are reported
Gene set size window of 15-500 is applied after intersection with the tested genes, and the window is stated with the results
Significant sets (BH-adjusted) are reported with normalized enrichment score, adjusted p-value, set size and leading-edge genes with their Wald statistics
Redundant sets are collapsed into groups with one representative reported per group, and the full uncollapsed table is retained
The gene set collection name and version, the universe (tested genes), the ranking metric, the size window and the permutation seed are all recorded
constraints: Rank on the full tested gene list — do not threshold on padj or log2FC before the enrichment test
Use the Wald statistic as the ranking metric; do not use the unshrunken log2 fold change alone and do not use a signed p-value that ties at zero
Set the universe to the genes tested in T1S2, never the whole genome or the whole annotation

Match the organism: only human collections may be used on ortholog-mapped symbols, and only zebrafish annotation on native zebrafish symbols — never a human collection against raw zebrafish symbols (case and nomenclature differ and the failure is silent)
If fewer than ~50 genes reach padj < 0.05 in T1S2, do NOT run an over-representation test on that short list — report the ranked result only and state the size of the significant list
Set and report a random seed for the fgsea permutations
State the limit of each path in the output: the ortholog map drops genes without a one-to-one human ortholog; the zebrafish GO annotation is sparser than the human one
caveats: Danio rerio has no curated MSigDB collection — both available paths are compromises, and results from the two paths may disagree; report both rather than choosing the more favourable
Enrichment results are method-dependent; a significant set is a hypothesis for follow-up, not a demonstrated mechanism
Zebrafish has many duplicated (ohnologous) genes, so one-to-one human ortholog mapping loses a substantial and non-random fraction — the loss is biased toward duplicated gene families
Gene length and expression level bias enrichment on count data; the ranked test on the tested-gene universe mitigates but does not remove this

grounding.reason: Preranked fgsea on the full tested list is the default enrichment (R-0107, R-0045); organism is neither human nor mouse so R-0050 requires the ortholog or GO path with its limit stated; for the disputed ranking metric (R-0108) this plan chooses the DESeq2 Wald statistic, per R-0099.

steps.name: Consolidated report
steps.question: What is the defensible answer to 'which genes differ between treated and control zebrafish larvae, and which pathways do they point to', with its power and annotation limits stated?
steps.description: Assemble a single report from T1S1, T1S2, T1S3 and T2S1. Lead with the power statement for n=3 per group before any gene table. Then: method and package versions; the design formula and the contrast written as (condition, treated, control); the thresholds; the number of genes tested after filtering out of 12,000 and the number significant at padj < 0.05; the MA plot, dispersion plot and p-value histogram; the gene table ranked by the apeglm-shrunken log2 fold change and carrying the unshrunken estimate and its standard error beside it; the DESeq2/edgeR overlap with the intersection named as the high-confidence set; the enrichment results with database and version, ranking metric, universe, size window, and the leading-edge genes of each reported set; the ortholog mapping share and the annotation source, release and identifier space; and a reproducibility record with sessionInfo, seeds, package versions and collection versions.
steps.context: Danio rerio whole-larvae bulk RNA-seq, 3 drug-treated vs 3 control pools, gene-level Salmon counts as symbols. The report is the deliverable that answers the research question; the constraints below are the reporting requirements that make the result checkable.
acceptance_criteria: The expected-power statement for 3 replicates per group appears before the gene tables, and states explicitly that a gene absent from the significant list is not shown to be unchanged
Method, package versions, design formula, contrast direction, thresholds, number of genes tested and number of DE genes are all present
MA plot, dispersion plot and p-value histogram are included with a one-line reading of each
Gene table is ranked by the shrunken log2 fold change and carries unshrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE alongside, with the shrinkage estimator named
DESeq2 and edgeR significant counts and their intersection are reported, with the intersection identified as the high-confidence set

Enrichment section names the gene set database and version, the ranking metric, the universe, the size window, the multiple-testing method, and lists leading-edge genes per reported set with overlaps marked
The annotation source, its release, the gene identifier space, the ortholog map used and the mapped share are stated
A reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, collection versions) is stored with the results
constraints: State that the enrichment result depends on the method chosen and present each gene set as a hypothesis for follow-up, not as an established finding
Do not rank or plot genes by the unshrunken log2 fold change alone
Do not present the union of the DESeq2 and edgeR calls as the result
Carry forward T1S2's statement that only gene-level counts were available, so the Salmon transcript-length offset was not applied
Report both enrichment paths (ortholog-mapped human collections and native zebrafish GO) with their respective limits — do not report only the one with more significant sets
caveats: Three pools per group is a small, underpowered design; the honest framing is a shortlist of large-effect candidates plus coordinated pathway shifts, not a comprehensive account of the drug response
No batch or covariate information exists in the metadata beyond condition, so any unmeasured technical difference between the pools is indistinguishable from the treatment effect

grounding.reason: Report contents follow the returned report-step rules: power statement first (R-0094), two-method overlap (R-0042), shrunken plus unshrunken effects (R-0085), fit diagnostics (R-0087), method and threshold reporting (R-0041, R-0051), method-dependence caveat (R-0055), non-model-organism annotation reporting (R-0081), leading edge (R-0105) and the reproducibility record (R-0086).
